description: This file defines the LeaveType entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It models a leave type with properties such as id, name, situational flag, deletion status, operational country, and related leave entitlements. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Entity\LeaveType
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave type with properties for id, name, situational status, deletion status, associated operational country, and related leave entitlements.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the leave type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the leave type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave type.

methods.name: isSituational
methods.description: Checks if the leave type is situational.

methods.name: setSituational
methods.description: Sets whether the leave type is situational.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deleted status of the leave type.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Returns the associated OperationalCountry object if any.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Associates an OperationalCountry object with this leave type.
